title: In 2022, he built a solar device to extract water from Death Valley air; in 2025, he won a Nobel Prize
summary_full: Omar Yaghi’s innovative team has created a groundbreaking device that pulls water from the atmosphere under adverse conditions. Employing a specialized metal-organic framework, their technology functions independently of electric power. Yaghi’s personal journey significantly shaped his commitment to tackling water scarcity. Their remarkable achievements earned them the Nobel Prize in Chemistry, and future expansions may enhance the reach of this technology.
